scope: Independent read-only check of previously omitted SS-01GL2 solder-terminal and lower-lug drawing envelopes against frozen R3 native geometry. Does not modify or re-certify the earlier proxy-based report.
method: Native watertight STL/manifold Boolean; independent raw-STL vertex bounds; exact rectangular probe sweep for all preload values;201 numerical witnesses plus the two native preload2poses. No remeshing, repairs or fabrication geometry edits.

manufacturer_drawing.drawing_interpretation_by: Independent mount_redesign dimension audit, dimension-audit.json; exact dimensions visually checked against manufacturer PDF
manufacturer_drawing.mapping: Manufacturer U maps Y=U-17; V maps X=V+14; housing thickness centre Z9.2. Mounting-axis line X16.5; tab tips6.4below that line give X10.1.
manufacturer_drawing.profile_limits: Rectangular bounding envelopes, not actual terminal solids. Exact tab corner/Ø1.6hole profiles and lug profile are not fully dimensioned. Their absent details cannot be recovered by assigning arbitrary contours.

stroke_domain: 0<=stroke_mm;0<=preload_mm<=2;stroke_mm+preload_mm<=30. Terminals and P05-relative clearance depend on preload only; P05 does not follow stroke.

terminal_clearance.interpretation: Native P05 fills the entire drawing-envelope cross-section at the nominal terminal tip at preload2. The envelope therefore fails the nominal full-preload packaging check.4.32mm³ is box-envelope intersection, not a claim of exact factory metal collision volume. Factory STEP or measurement is still required to resolve precise terminal profiles and routing.

fixed_frame_and_body_checks.meaning: No nominal terminal-envelope intrusion into fixed frame

lower_mount_lug.shape: Conservative full-length strip; not actual lug profile
lower_mount_lug.conditional_thickness_assumption: The projecting lug stays inside the dimensioned 6.4mm housing thickness, Z6..12.4. PDF does not independently dimension lug Z/profile; exact factory CAD/measurement still needed.
lower_mount_lug.native_support_contact: Envelope bottom Z6 coincides with P01 pedestal top Z6; this is a nominal support contact, not positive-volume interference.

terminal_broadphase.limit: Translation broadphase for terminal envelopes only. Spring/lever shapes remain illustrative, not manufacturer-qualified kinematics; their local bounds are separate from the terminal area.

remaining_unresolved: Exact SS-01GL2 manufacturer STEP unavailable to this audit; no surrogate variant was treated as the exact factory part.
Terminal holes/corners, lug Z/profile and actuator mechanism are not fully defined by available drawing; rectangular envelopes do not prove exact physical metal volume.
No dimensional tolerance stack, solder fillets, insulated leads, bend radii or assembly/service wire-routing envelope is included.
Switch operation point, total allowed travel and mount clamping/washer suitability require separate confirmation; this check does not qualify the kinematic proxy or force mode.
Resolve drawing-envelope terminal/P05 clash and rerun actual factory geometry checks before claiming installation works through the complete preload range.
